recipes.2a05653d-cf8c-5dcb-9cdc-5aae1929cd17: WITH premier_league AS (SELECT leagueid FROM football_leagues WHERE name = 'Premier League'), games_2015 /* 筛选2015赛季英超的比赛 */ AS (SELECT gameid, hometeamid, awayteamid FROM football_games WHERE season = '2015' AND leagueid = (SELECT leagueid FROM premier_league)), head_shots_with_team /* 获取所有头球射门记录并关联球队 */ AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS xgoal, teamid FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS xgoal, g.hometeamid AS teamid FROM football_shots AS s JOIN games_2015 AS g ON s.gameid = g.gameid WHERE s.shottype = 'Head' GROUP BY hometeamid UNION ALL SELECT AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS xgoal, g.awayteamid AS teamid FROM football_shots AS s JOIN games_2015 AS g ON s.gameid = g.gameid WHERE s.shottype = 'Head' GROUP BY awayteamid) GROUP BY teamid), head_shot_stats /* 计算头球射门统计 */ AS (SELECT teamid, AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_xg, COUNT(*) AS head_shot_count FROM head_shots_with_team WHERE NOT teamid IS NULL GROUP BY teamid), total_shot_stats /* 计算总射门统计 */ /* 合并统计结果并关联球队名称 */ AS (SELECT SUM(total_shot_count) AS total_shot_count, teamid FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shot_count, g.hometeamid AS teamid FROM football_shots AS s JOIN games_2015 AS g ON s.gameid = g.gameid GROUP BY hometeamid UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shot_count, g.awayteamid AS teamid FROM football_shots AS s JOIN games_2015 AS g ON s.gameid = g.gameid GROUP BY awayteamid) GROUP BY teamid) SELECT t.name AS "球队名称", h.avg_xg AS "平均xG值", h.head_shot_count / NULLIF(tst.total_shot_count, 0) AS "头球射门占比" FROM head_shot_stats AS h JOIN total_shot_stats AS tst ON h.teamid = tst.teamid JOIN football_teams AS t ON h.teamid = t.teamid

recipes.2db0171f-f629-5ff6-83aa-a2adec47a214: WITH split_content_rating AS (/* SQLite does not support LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE or SPLIT directly. */ /* Assuming the data is relatively simple or using a recursive CTE to simulate split is too complex for this context, */ /* we will use a recursive CTE to split the semicolon-separated string. */ WITH RECURSIVE split_cte AS (SELECT app, installs, rating, '' AS content_rating, content_rating || ';' AS remain FROM googleplaystore UNION ALL SELECT app, installs, rating, SUBSTRING(remain FROM 0 FOR POSITION(';' IN remain)) AS content_rating, SUBSTRING(remain FROM POSITION(';' IN remain) + 1) AS remain FROM split_cte WHERE remain <> '') SELECT app, TRIM(content_rating) AS content_rating, installs, rating FROM split_cte WHERE TRIM(content_rating) <> ''), install_converted AS (SELECT app, content_rating, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') AS INT) AS installs_num /* SQLite does not have regexp_replace by default, but we can assume simple replacement for ',' and '+' */ /* or assume the user has a custom function. For standard SQLite, we often chain replace. */ /* Here we simulate removing non-digits. Since standard SQLite is limited, we assume '1,000+' format. */, CAST(rating AS REAL) AS rating_num FROM split_content_rating WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') /* Simulating: regexp_replace(installs, '[^0-9]', '') != '' */ <> '' AND /* Simulating: rating rlike '^[0-9\.]+$'. SQLite uses GLOB or LIKE, but ISNUMERIC isn't standard. */ /* We rely on CAST returning valid numbers or NULL/0 if invalid, or use a simple check. */ TYPEOF(CAST(rating AS REAL)) IN ('integer', 'real')), ranked_apps AS (SELECT content_rating, app, installs_num, rating_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY content_rating ORDER BY installs_num DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM install_converted) SELECT content_rating AS 内容分级, app AS 应用, rating_num AS 评分 FROM ranked_apps WHERE rank <= 10

recipes.b07541e8-aff6-5627-b72c-9a976096aa59: /* 获取英超2015赛季比赛基础信息 */ WITH premier_league_games AS (SELECT g.date, g.gameid, g.hometeamid, g.awayteamid, CAST(g.homegoals AS BIGINT) AS homegoals, CAST(g.awaygoals AS BIGINT) AS awaygoals FROM football_games AS g WHERE g.leagueid = '1' AND g.season = '2015'), home_teams /* 关联主队信息 */ AS (SELECT t.teamid, t.name FROM football_teams AS t), away_teams /* 关联客队信息 */ AS (SELECT t.teamid, t.name FROM football_teams AS t), complete_games /* 构建完整比赛视图 */ AS (SELECT p.date, ht.teamid AS hometeamid, at.teamid AS awayteamid, ht.name AS home_team, at.name AS away_team, p.homegoals, p.awaygoals, (p.homegoals + p.awaygoals) AS total_goals FROM premier_league_games AS p JOIN home_teams AS ht ON p.hometeamid = ht.teamid JOIN away_teams AS at ON p.awayteamid = at.teamid), team_avg_goals /* 计算球队平均进球 */ AS (SELECT teamid, AVG(goals) AS avg_goals FROM (SELECT hometeamid AS teamid, homegoals AS goals FROM football_games WHERE leagueid = '1' AND season = '2015' UNION ALL SELECT awayteamid AS teamid, awaygoals AS goals FROM football_games WHERE leagueid = '1' AND season = '2015') AS combined GROUP BY teamid), ranked_games AS (SELECT c.date, c.home_team, c.away_team, c.total_goals, t1.avg_goals AS home_avg_goals, t2.avg_goals AS away_avg_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_goals DESC NULLS LAST) AS goals_rank /* 关键修改：使用RANK()实现跳过名次 */ FROM complete_games AS c JOIN team_avg_goals AS t1 ON c.hometeamid = t1.teamid JOIN team_avg_goals AS t2 ON c.awayteamid = t2.teamid) SELECT date AS "date", home_team AS "home_team", away_team AS "away_team", total_goals AS "total_goals", home_avg_goals AS "home_avg_goals", away_avg_goals AS "away_avg_goals" FROM ranked_games WHERE goals_rank <= 5 /* 前五名（含并列） */ ORDER BY goals_rank NULLS FIRST, date NULLS FIRST
recipes.b0d3a7e5-d01d-529b-8677-bf5a58e97c07: WITH order_product AS (SELECT o.productid, p.category, CAST(o.totalamount AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS totalamount FROM e_orders AS o INNER JOIN e_products AS p ON o.productid = p.productid), category_avg_amount AS (SELECT category, AVG(totalamount) AS avg_amount FROM order_product GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(totalamount) > 200), product_order_count AS (SELECT p.category, o.productid, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM e_orders AS o INNER JOIN e_products AS p ON o.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.category, o.productid), ranked_products AS (SELECT category, productid, order_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY order_cnt DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk /* 将rn改为rnk避免关键字冲突 */ FROM product_order_count) SELECT r.category AS "category", r.productid AS "productid", r.order_cnt AS "order_count" FROM ranked_products AS r INNER JOIN category_avg_amount AS c ON r.category = c.category WHERE r.rnk = 1
recipes.b0fa147b-6a67-5aeb-9f06-826f34491e10: WITH sales_detail AS (SELECT p.product_category, CAST(TRIM(s.units) AS INT) * CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(p.product_price), '$', '') AS DECIMAL) AS sale_amount FROM toy_sales AS s INNER JOIN toy_products AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id), category_sales AS (SELECT product_category, SUM(sale_amount) AS category_total FROM sales_detail GROUP BY product_category), total_sales AS (SELECT SUM(category_total) AS grand_total FROM category_sales) SELECT cs.product_category AS "product_category", (cs.category_total * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT grand_total FROM total_sales), 0)) AS "sales_percentage" FROM category_sales AS cs WHERE cs.category_total > 50

recipes.b28ed359-35b7-52bf-84ac-555aa68000e2: /* 获取教师Joseph的teacherid */ WITH teachers_cte AS (SELECT teacherid FROM school_teachers WHERE firstname = 'Joseph'), subjects_cte /* 获取斯瓦希里语科目subjectid */ AS (SELECT subjectid FROM school_subjects WHERE subjectname = 'Swahili'), base_data /* 关联成绩表和学生表 */ AS (SELECT m.markobtained, m.studentid, s.firstname, s.lastname FROM school_marks AS m INNER JOIN teachers_cte AS t ON m.teacherid = t.teacherid INNER JOIN subjects_cte AS sub ON m.subjectid = sub.subjectid INNER JOIN school_students AS s ON m.studentid = s.studentid), avg_score /* 计算科学科目平均分 */ /* 筛选高于平均分的记录 */ AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(markobtained AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_mark FROM base_data) SELECT markobtained AS "markobtained", studentid AS "studentid", firstname AS "firstname", lastname AS "lastname" FROM base_data WHERE CAST(markobtained AS DOUBLE PRECISION) > (SELECT avg_mark FROM avg_score)

recipes.b3c5b164-d965-568d-9492-73c3007bb60d: WITH customer_states AS (SELECT customer_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING(address FROM POSITION(',' IN SUBSTRING(address FROM POSITION(',' IN address) + 1)) + POSITION(',' IN address) + 1)) AS state /* Extract state from address (assuming format: "Street, City, State") */ /* Using SQLite string functions to extract the third comma-separated part */ FROM online_shop_customers), joined_data AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, p.payment_method, p.transaction_status, cs.state FROM online_shop_orders AS o JOIN online_shop_payment AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customer_states AS cs ON o.customer_id = cs.customer_id), state_stats AS (SELECT state, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' AND transaction_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_attempts FROM joined_data GROUP BY state), overall_stats AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' AND transaction_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overall_completed, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overall_attempts FROM joined_data), state_comparison AS (SELECT state, CAST(completed_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(total_attempts AS REAL), 0) AS state_success_rate, (SELECT CAST(overall_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(overall_attempts AS REAL), 0) FROM overall_stats) AS overall_success_rate FROM state_stats WHERE total_attempts > 0), low_success_states AS (SELECT state FROM state_comparison WHERE state_success_rate < overall_success_rate) SELECT DISTINCT c.email FROM online_shop_customers AS c JOIN customer_states AS cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id JOIN low_success_states AS lss ON cs.state = lss.state JOIN joined_data AS jd ON c.customer_id = jd.customer_id AND jd.transaction_status = 'Failed'
recipes.b3f49899-f22d-5543-8249-07210df96304: WITH zero_stock_products AS (/* 筛选出库存为零的商品记录 */ SELECT category, productid FROM e_products WHERE CAST(stockquantity AS INT) = 0), category_statistics AS (/* 按商品类别统计库存为零的商品数量 */ SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS "zero_stock_count" FROM zero_stock_products GROUP BY category), ranked_categories /* 最终选择零库存商品数量最多的类别，包括并列情况 */ AS (/* 为每个类别的零库存商品数量进行排名 */ SELECT category, "zero_stock_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "zero_stock_count" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rank" FROM category_statistics) SELECT category AS "商品类别" FROM ranked_categories WHERE "rank" = 1
recipes.b5554418-e158-5384-80d2-60a49a6044ba: WITH product_cost_price AS (SELECT product_id, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(product_cost, '$', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) AS product_cost, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(product_price, '$', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) AS product_price FROM toy_products), sales_profit AS (SELECT s.store_id, st.store_city, SUM((p.product_price - p.product_cost) * CAST(s.units AS INT)) AS total_profit_diff FROM toy_sales AS s JOIN toy_stores AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id JOIN product_cost_price AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY s.store_id, st.store_city) SELECT store_city AS "store_city", store_id AS "store_id", total_profit_diff AS "profit_diff" FROM sales_profit
recipes.b7b71df0-be3f-545a-a04c-197d1ef89f34: WITH annual_rankings AS (SELECT entity, code, year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cellular_subscription DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM internet_users_data), top_10_years AS (SELECT entity, code, year FROM annual_rankings WHERE rank <= 10), consecutive_groups AS (SELECT entity, code, year, year - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity ORDER BY year NULLS FIRST) AS grp FROM top_10_years), consecutive_counts AS (SELECT entity, code, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_count FROM consecutive_groups GROUP BY entity, code, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT DISTINCT entity AS "国家" FROM consecutive_counts
recipes.bad04feb-9d73-5c70-b359-bfeb3fb9b3e8: WITH card_avg_limit AS (SELECT card_family, AVG(CAST(credit_limit AS BIGINT)) AS avg_limit FROM credit_card_card_base GROUP BY card_family HAVING AVG(CAST(credit_limit AS BIGINT)) > 60000), transaction_stats AS (SELECT c.card_family, AVG(CAST(t.transaction_value AS BIGINT)) AS avg_value FROM credit_card_transaction_base AS t JOIN credit_card_card_base AS c ON t.credit_card_id = c.card_number GROUP BY c.card_family HAVING AVG(CAST(t.transaction_value AS BIGINT)) > 10000) SELECT l.card_family AS "卡族" FROM card_avg_limit AS l JOIN transaction_stats AS s ON l.card_family = s.card_family

recipes.bbffcf99-f4f4-520a-b86b-536f5bcd75e4: WITH commercial_stores AS (SELECT store_id FROM toy_stores WHERE store_location = 'Commercial'), inventory_aggregation /* 关联库存表并聚合库存量 */ AS (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(CAST(i.stock_on_hand AS BIGINT)) AS total_stock FROM toy_inventory AS i INNER JOIN commercial_stores AS cs ON i.store_id = cs.store_id GROUP BY i.product_id), product_details /* 关联商品表获取商品信息 */ AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM toy_products AS p) /* 最终查询并取TOP10 */ SELECT pd.product_name AS "product_name", ia.total_stock AS "stock_on_hand" FROM inventory_aggregation AS ia INNER JOIN product_details AS pd ON ia.product_id = pd.product_id ORDER BY ia.total_stock DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

recipes.bde38cf2-6dae-5dbe-9fa5-7595b489352f: WITH av_dedup AS (SELECT countrydisplay, MAX(regiondisplay) AS regiondisplay FROM alcohol_life_expectancy_verbose GROUP BY countrydisplay), combined_data AS (SELECT av.regiondisplay, ad.country, CAST(ad.spirit_servings AS BIGINT) AS spirit_servings FROM alcohol_drinks AS ad INNER JOIN av_dedup AS av ON ad.country = av.countrydisplay), ranked_data /* 对各区域国家按消费量进行排名 */ /* 取各区域消费量前3国家 */ AS (SELECT regiondisplay, country, spirit_servings, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY regiondisplay ORDER BY spirit_servings DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM combined_data) SELECT regiondisplay AS "区域", country AS "国家", spirit_servings AS "烈酒消费量" FROM ranked_data WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY "区域" NULLS FIRST, "烈酒消费量" DESC NULLS LAST
recipes.be080607-2a6e-5c1d-b45f-775ced85e663: WITH transaction_fraud_data AS (SELECT t.transaction_id, f.fraud_flag, t.credit_card_id FROM credit_card_transaction_base AS t INNER JOIN credit_card_fraud_base AS f ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id), card_customer_data AS (SELECT c.card_number, c.cust_id FROM credit_card_card_base AS c), full_transaction_info AS (SELECT tfd.*, ccd.cust_id FROM transaction_fraud_data AS tfd INNER JOIN card_customer_data AS ccd ON tfd.credit_card_id = ccd.card_number) SELECT c.customer_segment AS "客户分组", (SUM(CASE WHEN f.fraud_flag = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS "欺诈交易占比" FROM full_transaction_info AS fti INNER JOIN credit_card_customer_base AS c ON fti.cust_id = c.cust_id LEFT JOIN credit_card_fraud_base AS f ON fti.transaction_id = f.transaction_id GROUP BY c.customer_segment
recipes.be8b0e1d-23f8-5180-8664-3c017d535deb: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT d.driver_id, d.experience_years, CAST(r.fare AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS fare FROM city_ride_drivers_data AS d INNER JOIN city_ride_rides_data AS r ON d.driver_id = r.driver_id WHERE d.city = 'Chicago' AND NOT r.promo_code IS NULL AND r.promo_code <> ''), driver_avg_fares AS (SELECT driver_id, experience_years, AVG(fare) AS avg_fare_per_ride /* 计算每个司机的平均每单收入 */ FROM filtered_data GROUP BY driver_id, experience_years), group_avg_fares /* 保留原经验年限组平均计算 */ AS (SELECT experience_years, AVG(fare) AS group_avg_fare /* 每组平均每单收入 */ FROM filtered_data GROUP BY experience_years), ranked_groups /* 保留原排名逻辑 */ AS (SELECT experience_years, group_avg_fare, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY group_avg_fare DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM group_avg_fares) /* 最终结果：展示最高收入组及组内司机的个人收入 */ SELECT d.experience_years, d.avg_fare_per_ride AS driver_avg_fare, g.group_avg_fare /* 司机个人单均收入 */ /* 所在经验组的平均单均收入 */ FROM driver_avg_fares AS d JOIN ranked_groups AS g ON d.experience_years = g.experience_years WHERE g.rnk = 1 /* 只显示最高收入经验组中的司机 */ ORDER BY d.avg_fare_per_ride DESC NULLS LAST

recipes.c02d3936-c892-5dd6-869c-27887ac417dd: WITH fraud_transactions AS (SELECT t.credit_card_id, t.transaction_value FROM credit_card_fraud_base AS f JOIN credit_card_transaction_base AS t ON f.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE f.fraud_flag = '1'), card_info AS (SELECT c.cust_id, ft.transaction_value FROM fraud_transactions AS ft JOIN credit_card_card_base AS c ON ft.credit_card_id = c.card_number), customer_info AS (SELECT CAST(ci.transaction_value AS DECIMAL) AS trans_value, cu.customer_segment FROM card_info AS ci JOIN credit_card_customer_base AS cu ON ci.cust_id = cu.cust_id) SELECT customer_segment AS "客户分组", AVG(trans_value) AS "平均欺诈交易金额" FROM customer_info GROUP BY customer_segment
recipes.c0a5b2c6-9c4e-5500-9dbd-c28f15645528: WITH joined_marks AS (SELECT m.teacherid, m.studentid, m.subjectid, CAST(m.markobtained AS INT) AS markobtained, t.firstname AS teacher_firstname, t.lastname AS teacher_lastname FROM school_marks AS m JOIN school_teachers AS t ON m.teacherid = t.teacherid), student_max_marks AS (SELECT teacherid, teacher_firstname, teacher_lastname, studentid, MAX(markobtained) AS max_mark FROM joined_marks GROUP BY teacherid, teacher_firstname, teacher_lastname, studentid), ranked_records AS (SELECT jm.teacherid, smm.teacher_firstname, smm.teacher_lastname, s.studentid, s.firstname AS student_firstname, s.lastname AS student_lastname, jm.markobtained, sub.subjectname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY jm.teacherid ORDER BY jm.markobtained DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM student_max_marks AS smm JOIN joined_marks AS jm ON smm.teacherid = jm.teacherid AND smm.studentid = jm.studentid AND smm.max_mark = jm.markobtained JOIN school_students AS s ON jm.studentid = s.studentid JOIN school_subjects AS sub ON jm.subjectid = sub.subjectid) SELECT teacher_firstname || ' ' || teacher_lastname AS "老师姓名", student_firstname || ' ' || student_lastname AS "学生姓名", markobtained AS "成绩", subjectname AS "科目名称" FROM ranked_records WHERE rn = 1
recipes.c0e5f775-2c8e-56a7-9f9b-22d9cc9fb7ad: WITH americas_spirit AS (SELECT a.countrydisplay AS "国家", CAST(b.spirit_servings AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS spirit_val FROM alcohol_life_expectancy_verbose AS a JOIN alcohol_drinks AS b ON a.countrydisplay = b.country WHERE a.regiondisplay = 'Americas'), country_avg AS (SELECT "国家", AVG(spirit_val) AS avg_spirit_val FROM americas_spirit GROUP BY "国家"), region_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_spirit_val) AS avg_val FROM country_avg) SELECT DISTINCT c."国家" FROM country_avg AS c WHERE c.avg_spirit_val > (SELECT avg_val FROM region_avg)
recipes.c379fdf8-2552-5cf6-83d7-b423bf5c8f6d: WITH active_drivers AS (SELECT Driver_ID, City, CAST(Experience_Years AS REAL) AS exp_years FROM city_ride_drivers_data WHERE Active_Status = 'Active'), driver_ratings AS (SELECT r.Driver_ID, CAST(r.Rating AS REAL) AS rt FROM city_ride_rides_data AS r INNER JOIN active_drivers AS d ON r.Driver_ID = d.Driver_ID), city_data AS (SELECT d.City AS city_name, d.exp_years, r.rt FROM active_drivers AS d INNER JOIN driver_ratings AS r ON d.Driver_ID = r.Driver_ID), city_stats AS (SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(exp_years) AS sum_x, SUM(rt) AS sum_y, SUM(exp_years * exp_years) AS sum_x2, SUM(rt * rt) AS sum_y2, SUM(exp_years * rt) AS sum_xy FROM city_data GROUP BY city_name), city_corr AS (SELECT city_name AS "城市", CASE WHEN (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y) > 0 THEN (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0) ELSE NULL END AS "关联系数" FROM city_stats WHERE n > 1), ranked_cities AS (SELECT "城市", "关联系数", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "关联系数" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "排名" FROM city_corr WHERE NOT "关联系数" IS NULL) SELECT "城市", "关联系数" FROM ranked_cities WHERE "排名" = 1 ORDER BY "关联系数" DESC NULLS LAST, "城市" NULLS FIRST
